scope: Configure GitHub Packages publish pipeline, normalize package naming to 'node-pptx-templater', and ensure standard 'npm install node-pptx-templater' consumption

tasks.title: Normalize Package Manifest Name to 'node-pptx-templater'
tasks.description: Ensure package.json has 'name': 'node-pptx-templater' as the primary canonical package identifier so it installs directly via 'npm install node-pptx-templater'. Verify repository URL, publishConfig, and export map declarations.

tasks.title: Add GitHub Packages & NPM Publishing CI/CD Workflow
tasks.description: Create or update .github/workflows/publish.yml to automate publishing to GitHub Packages (npm.pkg.github.com) while keeping the package installable as 'node-pptx-templater'. Configure GITHUB_TOKEN permissions (contents: read, packages: write), registry routing, scope mapping (.npmrc setup), and automated packaging triggers.

tasks.title: Update Documentation, Showcase & Installation References
tasks.description: Audit README.md, docs-site configuration, showcase scripts, and .agent memory to ensure all installation instructions, import statements, and code blocks uniformly demonstrate 'npm install node-pptx-templater' and const { PPTXTemplater } = require('node-pptx-templater').
